title: フェブラリーSにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the February Stakes. Maybe because it's the first race following Smart Falcon's declaration, the atmosphere at the venue feels unusually giddy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokyo Racecourse is the same venue where the Japanese Derby, one of Japan's leading races, is held.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At present, this race can't hold a candle to the popularity of the Derby, but Smart Falcon takes it on nonetheless, determined to win and get more people talking.
